fields.v: Partly (0.5): needs only an embedding model and an LLM, but upfront authoring of capsules (42 here) and registry maintenance cost are not quantified; the authors flag registry maintenance burden
fields.quote: PyCapsule places a programmer agent and an executor agent together inside a Docker container, enabling correction cycles that are informed by live execution traces
fields.where: §II.E Self-Debugging, Self-Refinement, and Execution Feedback, p. 3
fields.why: Docker appears only in the related work (PyCapsule); the paper does not state that MicroSkill needs a Docker sandbox, so that requirement is not supported (score unchanged).
fields.doubt: A justificação do Q13 diz que a abordagem precisa de 'Docker sandbox', mas o Docker só aparece no trabalho relacionado (PyCapsule, pág. 3), não na MicroSkill. Retira essa parte; a pontuação Partly mantém-se.
